app.name: NetO11y
app.description: Sites, devices and WAN links on one map, with the alerts open on them

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Network devices and interfaces discovered by the SNMP extensions (EXT_NETWORK_DEVICE, EXT_NETWORK_INTERFACE)

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: SNMP interface traffic, errors, CPU, uptime and synthetic ICMP latency and loss per device

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Syslog and SNMP traps linked to each network device

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: OneAgent network flows (default_network_flows bucket) for the application hop

scopes.name: storage:user.sessions:read
scopes.comment: Real user session counts per hour and per client subnet, to tell whether a network fault reached the users. No page, action or user detail is read

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Bucket metadata required by the DQL client

scopes.name: davis-copilot:conversations:execute
scopes.comment: Dynatrace Assist explains the selected cause, its impact and next steps from the app's own evidence

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Site hierarchy chosen by the team, shared by every user of the app

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Saving the site hierarchy for every user of the app

scopes.name: davis:analyzers:read
scopes.comment: Run dt.statistics.forecast, whose seasonal decomposition sees what a straight line through a month cannot

scopes.name: davis:analyzers:execute
scopes.comment: Reading the analyzer catalogue is a separate grant from running one; the forecast needs both

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: builtin:geo-settings, which the platform's MapView reads to know whether this tenant shows the world map. Without it the call answers 403 on every load and the component falls back to enabled, so a tenant that turned the map off would be ignored
